name: Coding
description: Modern coding stack: safe file read/write/edit + diff/patch, code search, read-only Git observation, Python sandbox, terminal, managed processes, structured test execution, coding checkpoints, linked worktrees, trusted review, Project context, memory/palace, and approved custom-tool management. No web search. Subagent/background-task tools deliberately excluded: they are flag-gated at registration (SUBAGENTS_ENABLED/BACKGROUND_TASKS_ENABLED) and would be dead profile references whenever those flags are off (TOOL-PROFILE-REFRESH-01).
